actually.definition: In fact or really; used to correct or clarify something.
actually.example: I thought the test was Friday, but it is actually Thursday.

another.definition: One more person or thing, or a different one.
another.example: Can I have another piece of paper?

aquarium.definition: A glass tank or building where fish and other water animals are kept.
aquarium.example: We saw colorful fish at the aquarium.

arrival.definition: The act of reaching a place.
arrival.example: We waited at the station for her arrival.

athlete.definition: A person who is trained or skilled in sports.

battery.definition: A device that stores energy and provides electrical power.
battery.example: The toy stopped working because its battery was empty.

business.definition: An organization or activity that sells goods or services.
business.example: Her family owns a small bakery business.

careless.definition: Not giving enough attention or thought to what you are doing.
careless.example: A careless mistake changed the answer.

century.definition: A period of one hundred years.
century.example: The castle was built several centuries ago.

champion.definition: A person or team that wins a competition.
champion.example: She became the school chess champion.

cheerful.example: He gave everyone a cheerful greeting.

children.definition: Young people; the plural of child.
children.example: The children played in the playground.

climate.definition: The usual weather conditions of a place over a long period.
climate.example: This region has a warm, dry climate.

clothing.example: Bring warm clothing for the mountain trip.

company.definition: A business organization that sells goods or services.

dinosaur.definition: A large reptile from a group that lived millions of years ago.
dinosaur.example: The museum displayed a dinosaur skeleton.

distance.definition: The amount of space between two places or things.
distance.example: The distance from school to my house is two kilometers.

excited.definition: Very happy and eager about something that is going to happen.
excited.example: The students were excited about the field trip.

finally.definition: After a long time, delay, or series of events.

giraffe.definition: A very tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat.
giraffe.example: The giraffe reached leaves high in the tree.

grammar.definition: The rules for how words and sentences are formed in a language.
grammar.example: We practiced English grammar in class.

grocery.definition: Food and other everyday items bought from a store.
grocery.example: We stopped at the grocery store for milk and bread.

guest.definition: A person invited to visit or stay somewhere.
guest.example: Our guest arrived just before dinner.

history.definition: The study or record of events that happened in the past.
history.example: We learned about ancient Egypt in history class.

hundred.example: The book has more than one hundred pages.

imagine.definition: To form a picture or idea in your mind.

january.definition: The first month of the year.

keyboard.definition: A set of keys used for typing on a computer or other device.
keyboard.example: She typed the message on the keyboard.

machine.definition: A device with moving parts that uses power to do work.
machine.example: This machine washes the bottles automatically.

mailbox.definition: A box where letters and other mail are delivered or collected.
mailbox.example: There was a postcard in the mailbox.

medicine.definition: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
medicine.example: The doctor told him when to take his medicine.

mistake.example: I found one spelling mistake in my paragraph.

mystery.definition: Something that is difficult to explain or understand.
mystery.example: The missing key remained a mystery.

nervous.definition: Worried or slightly afraid about what may happen.
nervous.example: She felt nervous before speaking on stage.

passport.definition: An official document used to prove identity and nationality when traveling abroad.
passport.example: Do not forget your passport at the airport.

pleasant.example: We had a pleasant walk by the river.

probably.definition: Used to say that something is likely to happen or be true.
probably.example: It will probably rain this afternoon.

project.definition: A planned piece of work that has a particular purpose.
project.example: Our science project is about clean energy.

quiet.definition: Making very little or no noise.
quiet.example: Please be quiet while the test is starting.

saturday.definition: The day of the week after Friday and before Sunday.
saturday.example: The game is scheduled for Saturday.

shoulder.definition: The part of the body where the arm joins the upper body.
shoulder.example: He carried the bag over his shoulder.

someone.example: Someone left a notebook on the desk.

spelling.definition: The way a word is written with letters in the correct order.
spelling.example: Check the spelling of each word before you submit your work.

strange.example: We heard a strange sound outside.

thirsty.example: After the run, everyone felt thirsty.

thousand.example: More than a thousand people attended the event.

thursday.definition: The day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday.
thursday.example: Our English test is on Thursday.

whale.definition: A very large mammal that lives in the ocean.
whale.example: We saw a whale from the boat.

while.definition: A period of time, or during the time that something happens.
while.example: Please wait here for a while.
